--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_rule_repr_roundtrip.py
@@ -0,0 +1,37 @@
+from lark.grammar import Rule, RuleOptions, Terminal, NonTerminal
+
+
+NAMESPACE = {c.__name__: c for c in (Rule, RuleOptions, Terminal, NonTerminal)}
+
+
+def check_roundtrip(rule):
+    restored = eval(repr(rule), NAMESPACE)
+    assert restored is not rule
+    assert restored.origin == rule.origin
+    assert restored.order == rule.order
+    assert restored.alias == rule.alias
+    assert len(restored.expansion) == len(rule.expansion)
+    for expected, actual in zip(rule.expansion, restored.expansion):
+        assert type(actual) is type(expected)
+        assert actual.name == expected.name
+        if isinstance(expected, Terminal):
+            assert actual.filter_out == expected.filter_out
+    for field in ('keep_all_tokens', 'expand1', 'priority',
+                  'template_source', 'empty_indices'):
+        assert getattr(restored.options, field) == getattr(rule.options, field)
+
+
+def test_roundtrip_with_filtered_terminals_and_all_options():
+    options = RuleOptions(
+        keep_all_tokens=True, expand1=True, priority=-3,
+        template_source='item', empty_indices=(True, False, False, True),
+    )
+    rule = Rule(NonTerminal('start'),
+                [Terminal('_SEP', True), Terminal('WORD'), NonTerminal('item')],
+                order=4, alias='renamed_start', options=options)
+    check_roundtrip(rule)
+
+
+def test_roundtrip_empty_and_default_rules():
+    check_roundtrip(Rule(NonTerminal('empty'), []))
+    check_roundtrip(Rule(NonTerminal('start'), [Terminal('A')], order=2))
spec.notes: The tests deliberately compare fields individually rather than relying on Rule equality. Any representation strategy satisfying the stated reconstruction contract is acceptable.

This must also work for empty expansions and default options. Keep rule and symbol equality and hashing semantics unchanged.
